metrics.ach: CA.steady(conn): mean of the last 500 ticks of per-tick user-to-user achievability min(100, 100 delivered/offered)
metrics.best_routing: per instance: max ach, min jpu/energy/components/m7 over OSPF, OLSR, BATMAN, AODV (CA P3/P6/P9 definitions for ach/jpu)
metrics.ci: CA.t_ci (Student t, n-1 dof); paired = CA.paired (exact Wilcoxon, sign test, t CI), ach also bootstrap 95 % (B=10000, seed 1); wins = instances where the learned arm is better in the metric good direction {'ach': 1, 'm7': -1, 'energy': -1, 'jpu': -1, 'components': -1}
metrics.jpu: CA.jpu(run) = sum(energy)/sum(delivered) per instance; jpu_pooled = sum over instances / sum over instances (the confirmatory J/u pool)
metrics.m7: CA.m7_teardowns_per_1000(run, CA.T_SEV[k]) relay-link teardowns per 1000 post-event ticks

provenance.mixed_tree_note: allowed explicitly (--allow-mixed-tree-pairing): the r4 engine is bit-identical to the frozen R3-lite tree c6c5de5 (tools/r4_identity_check.py: XL-DET and marl_static at 3600 ticks IDENTICAL; the smoke repeats XL-DET at 300 ticks on every new tree); pickles of older trees (Phase 0 / R2, 6b53f3f) rest on their own reproduction records; the trees of both sides are listed under `trees`
provenance.no_new_passes: the routing-protocol passes on 300-339 already exist in the R3-lite S6 pickles (all 8 arms, 64 passes per block); nothing was re-run

what: every arm on R3-lite topology seeds 300-339 x Scenarios A (recovery) and B (rescue_ops), 3600 ticks; per-arm mean and 95 % t-interval over the 40 instances; paired differences learned - comparator per instance
